title: Thai Chicken Tacos
description: A spicy twist on traditional tacos, featuring the flavors of Thailand and Mexico.

ingredients.name: Thai red curry paste
ingredients.notes: Adjust to taste for spice level

ingredients.name: Mexican taco seasoning
ingredients.notes: Or homemade blend of chili powder, cumin, and smoked paprika

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add Thai red curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes and taco seasoning. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by placing a portion of the chicken mixture onto a tortilla, then topping with radishes, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Serve with sour cream or Greek yogurt and shredded cheese, if desired.
